:::{#def-bernoulli}
#### Bernoulli distribution
<!-- def-equiv-ok: moved unchanged from _def-pdf-pmf-cdf.qmd by a mechanical split -->

A [discrete](#def-discrete-rv) random variable $X$ has the **Bernoulli distribution** with parameter $\prob \in [0, 1]$,
written $X \sim \Ber(\prob)$
[@wikipedia_bernoulli_distribution],
if:

$$
\ba
\Pr(X=x) &\eqdef \1{x\in \set{0,1}}\prob^x(1-\prob)^{1-x}\\
&= \begin{cases}
\prob, & x=1\\
1-\prob, & x=0
\end{cases}
\ea
$$

:::
